fieldData.description: Hey there! Come hang out with us and chat about all things crypto at our upcoming meet-up! We'll be discussing everything from digital currencies to blockchain and decentralized finance. Plus, our friends at Radix are generously sponsoring a free first cup of Starbucks coffee for all attendees. You don't have to be a crypto expert to join in on the fun - this is just a casual get-together with some new friends who share a common interest. So, bring your curiosity and questions! Can't wait to see you there!
fieldData.name: Community Meetup - Kuala Lumpur
